role: Local municipality / public hearing and draft EIS commenter
stance_basis: Village listed as commenter on draft EIS with known concerns about noise and screen planting loss from roadway widening
summary: The Village of Park Forest is listed as a local agency that received and commented on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Lincoln Highway reconstruction project. Based on the exemplar quote (from pages outside this window), the Village raised concerns about increased noise pollution and loss of established screen planting separating residential properties from Lincoln Highway traffic as a result of the roadway widening. Within this window, the Village appears only in administrative listings as a recipient and commenter on the draft EIS, with no full statement or response visible.
complaint_summary: The Village of Park Forest is listed among local agencies that commented on the Draft Environmental Statement, indicating it submitted comments on the proposed Lincoln Highway improvement.
summary_quote: A. Widening of the roadway will bring vehicular traffic closer to single-family residences located within the Village of Park Forest which border upon Lincoln Highway. This will have two effects: First of all, there will be an increase in noise pollution; secondly, unless corrective steps are taken soon we will lose a well established screen planting which was developed for the purpose of separating the single-family residences from Lincoln Highway traffic.

mentions.quote: Recently, the Park Forest Station Consolidation Study was cancelled by the Village of Park Forest. (Village of Park Forest Resolution No. R-74-12)
Therefore, the Illinois Department of Transportation requested the Village of Park Forest to pass a resolution utilizing their Motor Fuel Tax Funds to pay for the replacement screen plantings.
